variant.changelog:
## New Update!
- Replaced the tracker visuals with a new better one
- Removed the previous custom-drawn tracker icon, panel-style text box, borders and framing
  - Switched the tracker to use fixed in-game icon
  - Added a game-icon based arrow indicator for off-screen tracking
  - Updated the tracker label to use a floating text style
  - Added pulse/glow effects to the tracker icon and off-screen arrow
- Updated tracker positioning behavior for on-screen/off-screen
- New **Tracker scale** option
  - Added scale handling to the tracker renderer so icon, arrow and text scale accordingly

`Never been so easyer to spot Maidens`
